_meta.description: TOC Analytics Environment -- Synthetic demo dataset
_meta.organization: Rose City Physicians Group (synthetic stand-in for The Oregon Clinic)

grain_notes.fact_encounter: One row per patient encounter. Full date available.
grain_notes.fact_referral: One row per referral. Full date available.
grain_notes.fact_appointment: One row per appointment. Full date available.
grain_notes.fact_claim_month: Pre-aggregated monthly. No day-level financial questions.
grain_notes.fact_denial_month: Pre-aggregated monthly. No day-level financial questions.
grain_notes.fact_ar_month: Month-end AR snapshots. No day-level AR questions.

known_limitations: Financial data (claims, denials, AR) is monthly grain only.
No scheduling wait time or third-next-available panel.
No ICD diagnosis codes. Clinical questions by condition not answerable.
No patient satisfaction or HCAHPS data.
No cost data. Margin questions not answerable.
No physician compensation or incentive data.
Referral destinations cover 25 synthetic organizations only.
All data is static and synthetic.
New patient uses 30-day window from first_visit_date.
Appointments and encounters are not joinable at the row level.
Row-level facts are a 5,000-row stratified sample of the full dataset.
